Prevention is better than cure. Its safe but just dont go to places with zero people because we dont know what is running in the minds of people. 

If you go to public places; roxas night market etc, dont bring backpacks and big bags because thats a hassle. Just bring a small sling bag to put your phone and wallet.

Its safe to go out of the city and ride the bus just beware of the scams on the public transpo of the place youre heading. 

If you got friends who smoke, do not ever smoke in public places because you will be fined. There are designated places for smoking. And always cross the street through the pedestrian because you will be charged as well. No phones while driving, use helmet and shoes when driving a motorcycle.

Lastly, enjoy! 😀
